text:
maria: Quick follow-up on fused-attn variants from the RFC — I sketched a small runtime toggle that prefers fused qkv+bias+rope when seq_len < 2048 and heads % 8 == 0. Thoughts?

ben: Personally fine with a preference but we need deterministic fallbacks if fusion fails at runtime. last week saw a silent fallback that changed outputs subtly.

devon: @maria can you paste the toggle snippet? Also we should emit telemetry when fallback happens so we can correlate with eval regressions.

maria: sure, pasted below (very crude):
```json
{
  "runtime": {
    "fused_attn": {
      "prefer": ["qkv_bias_rope", "qkv_bias", "qkv"],
      "conditions": {
        "max_seq_len": 2048,
        "head_multiple": 8,
        "disable_dropout_path": true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

alice: Couple of notes from ops: 1) the bias+rope fusion requires an adjusted rope_offset calc when reusing cached KV. 2) disabling dropout path for inference is fine but we need to document behaviour for attention masks.

lucy: On the quantized models, fused qkv+bias layout differs across torchscript kernels. We might want a canonical in-memory layout conversion at load-time to avoid per-batch transposes. That reduces runtime jitter.

ben: +1 on load-time conversion. Also propose a tiny determinism test in the ci-eval job: run N=3 inferences with fusion enabled/disabled, diff outputs bitwise for top-k tokens.

devon: Agreed. Telemetry plan: emit event `fused_attn.selection` with fields [chosen_variant, seq_len, head_count, fallback_reason]. Store sample hashes for select requests (not raw tokens) to detect regressions.

maria: For fallback reasons, common ones are: mismatched rope offset, unsupported head_count, kernel OOM, or layout mismatch. We should have unique enum codes.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: fused_attn_toggle=v1 -> canary-gpu-2 (25% traffic) :rocket:

alice: After canary, run the determinism CI and the eval prompt set (reasoning-100). If we see >0.2% top-1 diffs, rollback the toggle.

devon: I'll add the telemetry hooks and the CI check. @maria can you open a tiny follow-up RFC that documents the load-time layout conversion and the fallback enum? Then we can close this thread and track there.

maria: Will open RFC today, tagging follow-ups and adding the example config. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
